method: All rows enumerated from the public bazaar discovery surface GET https://facilitator.payai.network/discovery/resources?limit=500&offset=N (full pagination, 24084 items at as_of). Dedup by (resource url + mcp toolName) -> 24011 unique endpoints. Handshake verification: exactly one unauthenticated GET per candidate endpoint, expecting a 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED response; sample of 150 endpoints across 118 hosts (<=2 requests per host, <=1 request/second per host, no robots.txt applicable to API paths; User-Agent identifies the survey). No payments were made. Reproducible by rerunning census.mjs (same crawler logic, full crawl); drift is expected as the catalog is live.
